topic.title: Deck Image Renderer Notebook: English / Japanese card images

messages.content:
I made a small notebook to render PTCG deck images from Card IDs.

Notebook link:
https://www.kaggle.com/code/ichigoe/deck-image-renderer-visualize-your-ptcg-deck

It supports both:

  • hardcoded deck lists in the notebook
  • external deck.csv

It can generate deck images in both English and Japanese using the official card PDFs.

Hope it helps when checking, sharing, or explaining decks!
